title: China’s Dark Factories: So Automated, They Don't Need Lights | WSJ
summary: A WSJ report on China's 'dark factories', highly automated plants run by robots with little human presence, visiting Zeekr's EV factory. It covers Chinese labor costs, automation and overproduction in the EV industry.
why: HN cites it as evidence that lights-out factories exist, though one commenter notes it is outdated relative to current automation.

quote.text: some Chinese factories are so completely automated now that they don't bother turning on the lights
